caption:
Here’s the workflow:

Before you paste a single prompt into Claude Design:
1. Create a new Project called Instagram Carousels
2. Upload screenshots of 2–3 carousels you genuinely like
3. Upload your post or article
4. Write one prompt and it’s done

comment CAROUSEL and I’ll send the prompt to you immediately
author: Anjela Petkova

title: Claude AI Workflow for Instagram Carousels
one_liner: Use Claude's Project feature to auto-generate Instagram carousels from your articles with one prompt.
key_points: Create a Claude Project named 'Instagram Carousels' to keep context organized
Upload 2–3 carousel examples you like as style references
Add your article or post content to the project
Write a single prompt and Claude generates a ready-to-use carousel
